raw_sections.summary:
Summary
AI Engineer with 7+ years of experience and a master’s degree, specializing in GEN AI, LLMs, NLP, CV, and Deep Learning seeking opportunities to apply expertise in cutting-edge technologies and contribute to groundbreaking projects.
raw_sections.experience:
Experience
Intel Technology India Private Limited (GENAI Engineer)	JAN 2024 – PRESENT (INDIA)
Developed an AI agent with LangGraph to enhance CUDA-to-SYCL/oneAPI kernel translation for Intel GPUs, extending the capabilities of the existing DPCT tool by 80% and validating performance through benchmarks on ML repositories.
Designed and deployed Intel’s iGPT Platform, integrating GEN AI with Gaudi2 and Xeon processors to optimize infrastructure, reducing latency by 42% and costs by 80%. Deployed open-source LLMs (Qwen, LLaMA, DeepSeek) using LoRA and adapter tuning, achieving 87% model accuracy, served via vLLM for real-time inference.
Accelerated the FAISS library on Intel Iris Xe iGPUs by building a SYCL-based vector search pipeline, achieving sub-millisecond query performance on datasets up to 131K vectors with scalability through USM, persistent GPU memory, and adaptive batching.
Fine-tuned Code LLaMA models with LoRA/adapter strategies to build an in-house Copilot system, enabling intelligent code completion with 91% accuracy and documentation understanding across 120 enterprise codebases.
Built production-ready RAG pipelines by fine-tuning Embedding models (BGE-Multilingual, BERT) and Rerankers (MiniLM, MS MARCO), using LangChain and LlamaIndex to develop APIs and SDKs that enhanced downstream application integration.
Samsung Semiconductors India Research (Data Scientist)	March 2022 - JAN 2024 (INDIA)
Led Machine Breakdown Early Alarm Tracking project, achieving 95% accuracy using auto-encoder and Transformer architectures. Detected equipment breakdowns based on sub-process patterns, enhancing operational efficiency.
Executed model in real-time fabrication lab, averting failures. Enhanced accuracy to 98% using Reinforcement Learning. Filed patent for revolutionary maintenance system, recognized with Samsung Best Paper Award acceptance for EA.
Formulated cutting-edge Natural Language Processing system with Generative AI, incorporating LLM models like OPENAI, T5, ZEPHYR and fine-tuning for 90% performance boost. Improved equipment efficiency and maintenance practices.
Developed agents with Langchain, LlamaIndex, and Vector DB, and incorporated RAG for retrieval-augmented generation, leading to 90% improvement in solution provision accuracy for equipment breakdown resolution. Employed techniques like LORA, Adapters for further finetuning and optimization.
Mando Softtech India PVT. LTD. (Data Scientist)	Jan 2021 – Feb 2022 (INDIA)
Developed 3D object detection algorithm for Level 5 Autonomous Driving, integrating LIDAR, CAMERA, and RADAR data. Optimized models, enhancing MAP by 15%.
Proficient in multi-object tracking using Kalman Filter. Implemented custom C/C++ version of SORT algorithm, increasing MAP by 27%. Employed IOU-based association for precise tracking. Ported solution to QUALCOMM (6155 and 8155) and experimented on NVIDIA board for real-time detection and tracking.
SPI Technologies Private Limited (Data Scientist)	Oct 2019 - Jan 2021 (INDIA)
Extracted information from scanned documents at ECRASH using Faster RCNN for field identification. Applied OCR and NLP techniques, achieving 85% accuracy. Deployed the model using Docker on AWS.
Developed intent and entity detection systems for a product ranking and recommendation system within chatbot application and established Question Answering system for querying SQL databases. Enabled for non-tech users, cutting engineering work by 90% and achieved 71% chatbot response rate with A/B testing, in Q4-21 deployed in 100+ stores, managing 0.1M+ cases, utilizing Azure and Databricks.
Worked on Transmap Sign Board Detection project, designing Faster RCNN algorithm for signboard detection. Achieved 98% MAP through model optimization and pruning. Rolled out using Flask and Docker on GCP.
Mentored two interns, providing guidance and support to enhance their skills and contribute effectively to the projects.
Continental AG (Graduate Engineer Trainee)	Oct 2018 - Oct 2019 (INDIA)
Utilized machine learning to create radar system tools with 98% accuracy. Created Python-based tools for software component testing.

SKILLS
Coding: C, C++, Python and SQL.
LLMs & Fine-Tuning : LLaMA, GPT, LoRA/QLoRA, DPO, MS MARCO, BGE Multilingual. Computer Vision : Faster R-CNN, OpenCV, Vision Transformers, Object Detection, Image Processing Deployment & optimization: Flask, Docker, Kubernetes, Triton Inference Server.
Frameworks & Libraries: Keras, TensorFlow, Pytorch, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Sklearn, Hugging Face, Numpy.
RAG & Agentic AI: RAG, LlamaIndex, PGvector, Langchain, GRAPH RAG, LangGraph, MCP Server.
